no-restricted-globals.name: eval
no-restricted-globals.message: eval() in a payments dashboard is never the answer.

no-restricted-syntax.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML injects unescaped HTML. If content is genuinely trusted, render it as text or sanitize at the boundary and add an explicit eslint-disable naming the source.
Casting a parsed request body with `as` is a compile-time claim, not a runtime check. Validate the shape where it is consumed (see lib/sync-drain.ts:45) or add an explicit type guard.
